hooks.command: $root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 0 }; Push-Location $root; $st = git status --porcelain 2>$null; if (-not $st) { Pop-Location; exit 0 }; git add -A; $names = (git diff --cached --name-only 2>$null | ForEach-Object { [IO.Path]::GetFileName($_) }) -join ', '; $stat = (git diff --cached --stat 2>$null | Select-Object -Last 1); git commit -m "Actualizar: $names" -m "$stat" 2>$null; git push origin HEAD 2>$null; Pop-Location
